_comment: Dataset manifest for the investigation-quality eval (evals/investigation).
Each case materializes a committed skeleton under corpus/skeletons/<skeleton>,
applies the listed commits (string edits, in order) and assesses the final tree.
ground_truth is the answer key: it is NEVER materialized into the target tree,
never concatenated into prompts, and a regression test asserts no GT string
reaches an LLM request. Edit paths are relative to the skeleton's target/ dir.
kind: vuln = planted defect; hard_negative = safe lookalike a weak agent flags;
benign = ordinary change; ambiguous = missing/ambiguous evidence where either
flagging or not is acceptable but CONFIRMING a finding is a false positive.
Commit messages are ordinary and never name the defect.
